page.overview:
Who is Dago?

Dago is one of the Franky Family's Kairiki Destroyers.

Dago is a large, somewhat rotund man with short, afro-style orange hair and thick sideburns. He wears the Franky Family uniform, consisting of a metal lederhosen with a pink star and a pair of specialized goggles, as well as brown pants.

Like the other Kairiki Destroyers, Dago is an abnormally large human, reaching up above the legs of regular-sized giants and towering above the other members of the Franky Family.

In his initial appearance in the anime, Dago's hair was incorrectly colored black. This was corrected in the Episode of Merry special.
